manifest.hypothesis: Every table except users/tags has only PRIMARY, so lookups by livestream_id, user_id, (start_at,end_at) scan whole tables: livestream_tags by livestream_id is 151s of DB time for 4711 calls (2738x rows examined/sent), icons by user_id 51s, themes/livestreams by user_id, reservation_slots by range, ng_words by (user_id,livestream_id), and the statistics ranking's per-user joins over livestreams/reactions/livecomments (~15ms each). Secondary indexes on those columns turn the scans into point/range reads and free the single core MySQL saturates (355s of statement time in a 60s run).
